title: Continuation of Benefits and Recovery Policy for Appeals and Grievances
content:
Services continued while an **Appeals and Grievances** case is pending build a continuation balance, which is waived or may be recovered when the case is decided.

## Policy statement

1. **What continues.** Where the case type offers continuation, previously authorized services that the decision ends, suspends or reduces continue while the case is pending, only up to the units and period of the original authorization.
2. **Request in time.** Continuation applies only when the member asks for it no later than the case type's continuation request period after the date on the notice being appealed or before the action's effective date, whichever is later. The continuation days are counted in calendar days from the day after the notice date, and a request on the last day is in time. The notice date is read from the plan's record for the decision reference the case is about, never from the member's recollection, and the case records whether continuation was requested.
3. **Booking.** Continued services are booked only while the case is in filed, acknowledged or under review status.
4. **Outcome.** When the case is overturned the whole continuation balance is waived; when it is upheld the balance may be recovered where the case type allows recovery, except a balance at or below the case type's recovery floor and except where the member states a financial hardship and the case type's hardship waiver applies.

## The continuation balance

The continuation balance of a case, in US dollars to two decimals, is the cost of services continued during the pending case that the member may have to repay if the decision is upheld. It rises by the plan's cost of each continued service claim paid, booked with its service date, claim number and posting date; it falls by each waiver, booked with its reason and posting date, and by each repayment the member makes, booked with its payment confirmation and posting date. A resolution of overturned or partially overturned books a waiver of the continued-service cost, with the reason "appeal overturned", posted on the resolved date.

## Recoverable amount

On an upheld case where the case type allows recovery, the recoverable amount is the whole continuation balance when that balance is greater than the recovery floor, and nothing when the balance is at or below the floor. Nothing is recovered where the member states a financial hardship and the hardship waiver applies.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures; a case type with a recovery floor of 25.00 USD, recovery allowed and hardship waiver applicable)

| Outcome | Continuation balance | Member states financial hardship | Recoverable |
|---|---|---|---|
| Upheld | 25.00 | No | Nothing: at the floor |
| Upheld | 25.01 | No | 25.01, the whole balance |
| Upheld | 180.40 | No | 180.40, the whole balance |
| Upheld | 180.40 | Yes | Nothing: hardship waiver |
| Overturned | 180.40 | Either | Nothing: the whole balance is waived |

## Request window (hypothetical dates; a 10-day request period)

| Notice date on record | Action's effective date | Last day of the 10-day count | Request made | In time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 5 March | 11 March | 11 March | Yes: last day of the count |
| 1 March | 5 March | 11 March | 12 March | No: after the count and not before the effective date |
| 1 March | 20 March | 11 March | 15 March | Yes: before the effective date, the later of the two limits |
